title: SB1654 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13, relative to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2024-01-09; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260514144656 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/113/Bill/SB1654.pdf (LegiScan doc 2872930))
provenance.note: Draft as filed (2024-01-09), Internet Archive copy of the official PDF; names House bill 1713 as twin. Effective July 1, 2024. Wording differs slightly from the 2023 HB 1439 draft.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1316(s)): (1) It is an offense to knowingly give, sell, lend, deliver, or otherwise transfer a firearm to a person when the transferor knows or reasonably should know that the person receiving the firearm is prohibited from purchasing or possessing a firearm under state or federal law.
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1316(s)): (2) A violation of this subsection (s) is a Class A misdemeanor.
